mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and dampening equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing demand (HOUST) indicates robust demand-side expansion, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases quarter-over-quarter and HOUST increases month-over-month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not outperform baseline when both proxies show growth (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction effect rank IC < 0.03 over 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and enhancing equity present value, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods with FEDFUNDS <2.5% do not outperform baseline (t-test p >0.05) or Rank IC <0.03 over 60-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightness signal as the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5% suggests weakening labor demand, increasing wage pressures and inflation risks, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in high-unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p >0.05) or Rank IC >0.03 over 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong growth in both quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and supply-side indicators (INDPRO) reflects a healthy economy, boosting corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases quarter-over-quarter and INDPRO increases month-over-month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns do not outperform baseline when both proxies show growth (t-test p >0.05) or interaction effect rank IC <0.03 over 60-day window.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in monthly labor employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in labor expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p >0.05) or Rank IC <0.03 over 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in monthly demand for goods and services (RSAFS) indicates improving economic conditions, reducing deflationary pressures and fostering optimism, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in post-shock recovery periods with RSAFS decreasing do not outperform baseline (t-test p >0.05) or Rank IC <0.03 over 20-day window.
